description: Source code for diagnostic and archive creation functions in a Git-related project, including directory traversal, file stats, and archive generation.

methods.name: option_parse_diagnose

methods.name: dir_file_stats_objects
methods.description: Collects file size statistics for files in a directory.

methods.name: dir_file_stats
methods.description: Generates stats for files in a pack directory.

methods.description: Counts the number of regular files in a directory.

methods.description: Gathers statistics on loose objects in a directory.

methods.name: add_directory_to_archiver
methods.description: Recursively adds directories and files to an archiver argument list.
